title: Control Props Basics
description: Understand the controlled props pattern for dual-mode components.

data.text: The **control props pattern** allows components to work in both controlled and uncontrolled modes. If a prop is provided, the component is controlled; if not, it manages its own state.

data.title: Controlled Input
Warning
data.text: Warn developers if they switch between controlled and uncontrolled modes, as this can cause bugs.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Components can work in both modes
Detect mode by checking if prop is undefined
data.takeaway: Control props provide flexibility for component consumers.
